english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that causes astonishment, such as an astonishing display.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for something astonishing, surprising, or shocking.
Choose this when the surprising thing is especially striking in scale, degree, or effect.
Choose this when the phenomenal quality is the striking scale or impact of a result, effort, or achievement.
Use this for a strikingly large, remarkable, or astonishing result, especially in attributive phrases.
Use this when “spectacular” emphasizes that something is astonishing or unusually impressive.
Use this when the main idea is that something is astonishing or remarkably impressive.
Use this when the result or achievement is strikingly noteworthy rather than simply a large-margin win.
Use this when the degree is strikingly high or remarkable, especially with speed, size, or other measurable intensity.
Use this for an accusation or other statement that is shocking or startling rather than physically dangerous.
Choose this when the size, achievement, or impact is strikingly astonishing.
Use 驚人 when the main point is that something is astonishing or remarkably unusual.
Use this when “scary” means astonishing or uncannily striking rather than frightening.
